I replied to Ilse in the thread on her message in #north-team. I confirmed that the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines has a 21 October deadline and that nothing needs doing.

The workspace knowledge base (gbrain) had nothing else on Osprey, so I found nothing that contradicts that date. Its search was running in a reduced, keyword-only mode, though, so that isn't proof nothing else exists. I didn't read the channels or files directly. Ilse's note was already saved there, under her name and #north-team.

Nothing was sent outside #north-team, and nothing involved finance figures, so no approval was needed.
